items.headline: Campbell hits 3 FGs as Western Kentucky defeats Sam Houston 16-3
items.description: — Brock Glenn and Coleson Arends connected on the game's lone touchdown, Karl Campbell hit all three of his field goal attempts, and Western Kentucky took down Sam Houston 16-3 on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Ajay Allen rushes for 105 yards and 2 touchdowns as Western Kentucky beats Missouri State 34-13
items.description: — Brock Glenn threw for a touchdown and ran for another, Ajay Allen rushed for 105 yards and two touchdowns, and Western Kentucky beat Missouri State 34-13 on Thursday night.
